name: CalEvents
description: Agent-readable UC Berkeley campus events discovery site. Public read-only feeds; no create/update/delete for events or status.

supportedInterfaces.description: Browser-only WebMCP tools on the CalEvents homepage: ranked search, filter options, URL workspace with a view snapshot, ICS, and directions. No remote endpoint.
Read-only public event data interface described by OpenAPI. No write operations.

skills.name: Search Berkeley events
skills.description: Find upcoming UC Berkeley events by keyword, date, category, topic, source, organizer, or location. Topic slugs come from events.json.topic_vocabulary.topics or list_filter_options. Results report dropped filters and support paging.

skills.name: Inspect event feed status
skills.description: Inspect source freshness, fallback usage, and ingestion status.

skills.name: Event detail
skills.description: Look up one event by id with directions (get_event_directions) and calendar links.

skills.name: Calendar export
skills.description: Generate .ics or Google Calendar URLs for an event.

skills.name: Share event
skills.description: Build shareable CalEvents deep links from URL workspace params or the open page (get_ui_state).
